texts.preamble: Mohan Kumar B.S vs Divakar M. Narayana on 3 January, 2026 In The Court Of Iii Addl.Judge And Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Court Of Small Causes Bengaluru (Scch-18) Dated: this the 3rd day of January 2026 Present: Dhanesh Mugali B.Com., LL.B.,(Spl.) Iii Addl. Judge & Member, Mact, Court Of Small Causes, Bengaluru. Mvc No.3325/2023
texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/- for the injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident. Brief facts of the petitioner's case are as under: 2. That on 24-07-2022 at about 10-30 p.m. the petitioner was riding his motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA-02/JE-2725 from Petrol Bunk towards Vidyaranyapura on the extreme left side on HMT Main road, Bengaluru city, when he reached in front of Kadamba Hotel, at that time, driver of Hyundai Car bearing registration No.KA-01/MX-1389 parked the said vehicle negligently without indicator, that too in the late hours, as a result of which the petitioner dashed the back side of said Car and sustained grievous injuries. 3. It is further stated that, immediately he was shifted to Omega Multispecialty Hospital, Yelahanka for first aid, then he was shifted to K.I.M.S. hospital, Bengaluru for further treatment, wherein he took treatment as an inpatient and undergone surgery and spent more than Rs.2,50,000/- towards transportation, treatment, medicines, conveyance etc., 4. It is stated that, prior to the accident the petitioner was hale and healthy and working as Sales Manager in Indian Petrol Bunk, Jalahalli, Bengaluru and earning Rs.25,000/- p.m. Due to accidental injuries, he could not able to do his work as earlier. 5. It is stated that, the accident occurred due to negligent act of driver of the Hyundai Car bearing Registration No.KA-01/MX-1389. Hence the Jalahalli Traffic Police have filed charge sheet against driver of said vehicle in Cr.No.72/2022. As such, the respondent No.1 & 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation to the petitioner. Hence, the petitioner has filed the instant petition, seeking compensation. 6. After service of summons, respondent No.1 and 2 appeared through their respective counsel and filed the written statements. 7. In the written statement the respondent No.1 stated that he is the RC Owner of the the Hyundai Car bearing Registration No.KA-01/MX-1389 and the said vehicle was insured with respondent No.2 and policy was in force as on the date of accident and the driver of offending vehicle had valid and effective driving licence to drive the said vehicle as on the date of accident, hence respondent No.2 has to indemnify the respondent No.1. It is contended that the accident occurred due to sole negligence on the part of the petitioner. Further denied the age, avocation and income of the petitioner. Ultimately contended that the compensation claimed by the petitioner is excessive and exorbitant. With all these main grounds, prayed to dismiss the petition Mohan Kumar B.S vs Divakar M. Narayana on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69123199/ 2 with cost. 8. In the written statement, the respondent No.2 admitted about the issuance of policy in respect of Hyundai Car bearing registration No.KA-01/MX-1389 and the liability of this respondent is subject to terms and conditions of the policy. It is contended that, the driver of offending vehicle had no valid and effective driving licence to drive the said vehicle as on the date of accident, hence there is a violation of terms and conditions of the insurance policy. It is contended that the accident occurred due to sole negligence on the part of the petitioner, as he was not wearing the safety head gear Further stated that there is delay in lodging the complaint. With all these main grounds, prayed to dismiss the petition with cost. In order to substantiate his case, the petitioner got examined himself as PW1 and got marked the documents at Ex.P1 to Ex.P13. In addition to his evidence, placed the evidence of Dr.Jayaram B.S. as PW2 and got marked documents at Ex.P14 to Ex.P16. 11. On the other hand, the respondent No.2 has examined its Legal Manager as RW1. 12.
texts.arguments: 15. On the other hand, the respondents have contended that the accident occurred due to sole negligence on the part of the petitioner only and not on the part of the driver of the Hyundai Car bearing registration No.KA-01/MX-1389. 16. In the light of the rival contentions of both the parties, on going through the above issue burden is on the petitioner to prove the above issue on the touch stone of preponderance of probabilities. 17. The petitioner in order to prove his case got examined himself as PW1. He has reiterated the averments made in the petition. The petitioner in support of his oral evidence has relied upon the police documents as per Ex.P1 to Ex.P3, Ex.P6 to Ex.P9.
